answer: Make every identity re-express a stranger's answer in wholly new words each epoch. A genuine stranger's version carries its own timber — different metaphors, different emphasis — while one operator's masks all repeat the same whisper of phrasing, the same examples, the same slips. Their paraphrases float together like lotus leaves on one pond, near-identical. Score divergence across each cluster; low-divergence groups lose weight, so running many masks stops paying.
